rules.name: Destructive Recursive Deletion
rules.description: Detects commands attempting recursive deletion of sensitive system or home directories (e.g. rm -rf /, rm -rf ~)

rules.name: Unsafe Remote Script Execution
rules.description: Detects piped network downloads executing directly in shell (e.g. curl ... | bash, wget ... | sh)

rules.name: Raw Disk and Filesystem Format
rules.description: Detects low-level disk formatting or partition destruction utilities (mkfs, wipefs, dd of=/dev/sd...)

rules.name: Denial of Service Fork Bomb
rules.description: Detects self-replicating shell fork-bomb signatures causing host resource exhaustion

rules.name: Broad Wildcard Deletion
rules.description: Detects recursive deletion targeting broad wildcard patterns (*, .*)

rules.name: Unrestricted Privilege Escalation Request
rules.description: Detects requests for root shells or unrestricted privilege elevation (sudo su, su -, pkexec)

rules.name: Dangerous Global Permission Modification
rules.description: Detects application of world-writable permissions (chmod 777) or SUID bit modifications

rules.name: Security Control Deactivation
rules.description: Detects attempts to disable SELinux (setenforce 0), firewall (ufw disable, iptables -F), or security daemons

rules.name: Direct Private Credential Access
rules.description: Detects attempts to read SSH private keys, AWS credentials, GPG keyrings, or shadow password hashes

rules.name: Environment and Secret Variable Dumping
rules.description: Detects dumping of process environment variables containing active secrets into files or network streams

rules.name: Dynamic Evaluation of Remote Fetch
rules.description: Detects dynamic eval or execution of command substitutions pulling unverified remote content

rules.name: Persistence Configuration Modification
rules.description: Detects modifications to scheduled tasks (crontab), shell startup files (.bashrc, .profile), or systemd units

rules.name: Reverse Shell or Network Execution Pipe
rules.description: Detects network streaming tools (nc, ncat, socat) configured with program execution (-e / exec)

rules.name: Credential Exfiltration via Remote POST
rules.description: Detects network upload utilities sending local credential or key files to remote endpoints

rules.name: Obfuscated / Encoded Command Execution
rules.description: Detects encoded or obfuscated payloads (base64 -d, xxd -r) piped into interpreters

rules.name: Suspicious Nested Interpreter / Complex Chain
rules.description: Detects suspicious nested interpreter chains or unusually complex command structures reducing analysis confidence

rules.name: Unauthorized Security Config Modification
rules.description: Detects modifications to Cyravell audit logs, manifest files, or rule directories

rules.name: Standard Development Operation
rules.description: Standard development and build command operating within expected baseline parameters
